thread:
Lina: Hey folks! thinking of a 'Cozy Corner' supper sesh next Thurs 7pm in the 3rd-floor lounge. casual potluck + tiny dessert bake-off. anyone in? :cookie:
Omar: sounds delightful. i'll bring samosas (vegetarian). what are the dessert rules? :thinking_face:
Priya: i'm down. dessert rule: anything under 8 inches and shareable. judge by applause/cheers? :clap:
Ben: i'll bring plates and a battery fairy light string to make it cozy. also can do non-alcoholic punch.
Lina: love that. small prize idea: a gummy trophy? :trophy_face: (totally jokey)
Omar: count me as a judge if we need one. can we do a quick allergy tag on each dish? e.g., "gluten-free, nuts"
event-bot: Quick poll: React :one: if performing a short set (acoustic/poem), :two: if just attending, :three: if both. Poll expires in 72h.
Priya: @Omar there is a tiny sheet: https://tiny.rw/supper-sesh - please add dish + allergens.
Ben: i'll take mic check for a 30s kazoo performance. kidding... maybe.
Lina: also optional cozy corner movie projector after desserts? low-volume background. ok?
Omar: movie vote: old-school romcom or nature documentary? i'll put options in the sheet.
Priya: romcom 4 life.
Ben: nature doc for me. split screen? :laughing:
Lina: logistics: setup crew at 6:15 to lay blankets and test lights. volunteers?
Omar: i'll help move beanbags.
Priya: can do table setup.
Ben: i'll handle cleanup crew if others can help fade out by 9:30.
Lina: thanks! small ask: bring your own forks/spoons if possible to reduce disposables. i'll have a couple extras.
Omar: dietary heads-up: my samosa recipe uses ghee. i'll mark vegetarian but not vegan.
Priya: noted. i'll bring a vegan chocolate tart.
Ben: reminder for judges: keep opinions kind. it's a silly bake-off. :heart:
Lina: adding tiny running order in the sheet now. first desserts judged at 7:30, then performances if anyone signed up.
event-bot: Reminder set for Wednesday 10:00: "Final RSVP + bake-off signups"
Priya: also quick PSA: there is a toddler birthday party in the building that evening, may be a little extra noise in the lobby. just a heads up.
Lina: good to know. we'll keep doors closed and music low.
Omar: see y'all next Thursday! excited.
Ben: can't wait for gummy trophy content.
Lina: thanks everyone 18 will post final layout and volunteer list on Tuesday. :sparkles:
